newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-TRINIDAD TO FACE LUESHING, RANDALL TO FIGHT RAHILOU.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-TRINIDAD TO FACE LUESHING, RANDALL TO FIGHT RAHILOU.

text.p: NASHVILLE, Tennessee, Nov 20 Reuter - International Boxing Federation welterweight champion Felix Trinidad will fight England's Kevin Lueshing and World Boxing Association junior welterweight champ Frankie Randall will face Khalid Rahilou of France early next year, promoters announced Wednesday.

The January 11 card in Nashville also features World Boxing Council champion Terry Norris against Nick Rupa of Canada and unbeaten heavyweight contender Henry Akinwande against fellow Englishman Scott Welch.
The exciting Trinidad is 30-0 with 26 knockouts. Lueshing, the British Commonwealth champion, is 19-1 with 16 knockouts.
Randall, 53-4-1 with 40 inside the distance, faces a stiff test in Rahilou, the top-ranked contender. Rahilou is 28-2 with 14 stoppages.
Norris is 44-6 with 28 knockouts while Rupa, the 10th-ranked contender, is 26-4-1 with 14 knockouts.

Akinwande is 30-0-1 with 19 stoppages and is looking to force matchmakers to give him a big-money bout with one of the three heavyweight champions. Welch, the 10th-ranked contender, is 19-2 with 16 KOs.
